summary.intent: Execute phase 22 (performance baselines completion) plans, after first correcting that research/planning commits had landed directly on main instead of a feature branch.
summary.outcome: The 5 phase 22 planning commits were moved to `feat/phase-22-performance-baselines-completion`, main was reset to match origin/main, and phase 22 execution began with 3 agents spawned in parallel for wave 1 (SDK perf instrumentation, E2E journey timing, load test thresholds).

repo: Phase 22 is 'performance-baselines-completion' — covers SDK Performance API instrumentation, Playwright E2E journey timing, and load test threshold/capacity modeling.
GSD branching convention for phases is `feat/phase-{N}-{slug}`, not a separate planning branch.
Phase 22 has 3 plans all in wave 1 (no cross-plan dependencies), enabling full parallel execution.
workflow: Planning commits that land directly on main can be cleanly moved to a feature branch via: create branch at current HEAD, then `git reset --hard origin/main` on main — works as long as commits haven't been pushed.
GSD execute-phase uses the phase directory slug for the feature branch name, which must align with any manually created branch name.
When already on the correct feature branch, GSD's branching step (`git checkout -b`) is a no-op and can be skipped.

friction: Phase 22 research/planning commits were made directly to main instead of the intended feature branch, requiring manual branch surgery before execution could proceed.
open_items: Wave 1 agents (22-01, 22-02, 22-03) were spawned but the transcript ends before their completion — verification and roadmap update steps are pending.
Feature branch `feat/phase-22-performance-baselines-completion` has not been pushed to remote yet.
